Operator hand-re-expanded from the printed theta-form and confirmed to match. NOT the same normalization as OEIS A219692's closed-form combinatorial sum an = Sum_{k=0}^{floor(n/3)} (-1)^k C(n,k) C(2k,k) C(2(n-k),n-k) (C(2n-3k-1,n)+C(2n-3k,n)) — that sum evaluates to a(0)=2 (verified here), whereas this operator's own indicial recursion forces a(1)=6*a(0), which only closes consistently with A-vS's own printed phi(x)=1+6x+54x^2+... (a(0)=1), matching the operator's own printed power series, not the closed-form sum's boundary value. See _meta_note.
